# Vendored libraries

| Library | Version | Files |
|---|---|---|
| [fosu](https://github.com/cmyui/fast-osu-beatmap-parser) | `a17afca` | `fosu/` (headers from `src/fosu`) |
| [miniaudio](https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio) | 0.11.25 | `miniaudio.h` |
